publicQuestion: How many plane partitions fit inside a 5 × 6 × 7 box? Equivalently, how many 5×6 matrices with non-negative integer entries at most 7 are weakly decreasing along every row (left to right) and weakly decreasing down every column (top to bottom)? Give just the integer.

judgeNote.validityReason: The number of plane partitions fitting in an a×b×c box is given by MacMahon's box formula: prod_{i=1}^{a} prod_{j=1}^{b} prod_{k=1}^{c} (i+j+k-1)/(i+j+k-2). For a=5, b=6, c=7 this yields 739309710568. Verified by recomputing with permuted dimensions (all give the same answer, confirming symmetry), and validated against brute-force enumeration for the 2×2×2 case.
